body.name: Active-chart extension of the corrected common score
body.construction:
Fix the minimum-norm union coefficients \((a_x^U(P_0),d_x^U(P_0))\) from \(\mathrm{QP}_x\) at \(P_0\), retaining the same independent normal coordinates throughout its constant-rank neighborhood. For a nearby \(P\in\mathcal M_b\), define the branch-specific extensions
\[
 \phi_U^{\mathrm{loc}}(P;\mathrm{PT},P_0)
 =\chi_{\mathrm{PT}}(P)+\sum_x\{g^{\circ}_{\mathrm{PT},x}(P)+R_{\mathrm{PT},x}(P)^{\prime}a_x^U(P_0)\},
\]
and
\[
 \phi_U^{\mathrm{loc}}(P;\mathrm{SC},P_0)
 =\chi_{\mathrm{SC}}(P)+\sum_x\{g^{\circ}_{\mathrm{SC},x}(P)+R_{\mathrm{SC},x}(P)^{\prime}d_x^U(P_0)\}.
\]
Off the intersection the first term is deliberately branch specific; no equality of the two extensions is asserted.
